facts.fact: The telecommunications minister opened a national validation workshop on 7 October 2026 for Chad's draft Stratégie Nationale de Gouvernance des Données, with working-group amendments to go to plenary before adoption.
facts.system: Stratégie Nationale de Gouvernance des Données

TCD.note: The speech mentions protecting personal data as a strategy pillar but states nothing about a data protection law, authority, regulations or application.

facts.fact: The minister said Chad's draft national data governance strategy aims at a sovereign national data system in which the state knows where strategic data is hosted and who manages it.
facts.system: Stratégie Nationale de Gouvernance des Données

facts.fact: The ministry held a national validation workshop on 7 October 2026 on the draft national data governance strategy, with academics, civil society, the private sector and public institutions invited, and said the relevant actors had been consulted since launch.
facts.system: Stratégie Nationale de Gouvernance des Données
